SLA anchors the worldwide leaf economics spectrum [@wright_leaf_2004, p. 822]. #anchor spectrum

Mass-based photosynthetic capacity rises with SLA across biomes [@reich_global_1997]. #anchor photosynthesis

Biomass allocation varies independently of the spectrum [@poorter_biomass_2012]. #anchor allocation

I suspect [shade plasticity](id:shade-plasticity) confounds the spectrum's slope. #mine
